name: halo-replica-mlb
state: PROVISIONAL - every dimension is tagged; the outer diameter is a BOUND and the centre hole is PARTIALLY DETERMINED
side_convention: FRONT = COMPONENT SIDE (Apple FCC caption 'MLB - Front'). O'Flynn's 'frontside' is this project's BACK.
what_this_is: A parameterised annular board. NOTHING here is a hard-coded diameter: the outline is a normalised profile r(theta)/r_mean taken from a photograph, multiplied by one scale parameter. Change outer_diameter_mm and the whole board rescales.

outer_diameter_mm.state: BOUNDED, NOT A SINGLE NUMBER - the value above is the one DRAWN, not a settled diameter
outer_diameter_mm.bound_source: metrology/M02 - the two image axes do not share a scale (26.3 wide x 25.0 tall), so the OD is a bound and not a number
outer_diameter_mm.signed_expectation: IF THE BOUND MOVES, IT MOVES DOWN (M02 sec 8). Two reasons, both in place before the confirming measurement: the edge detector settles on a blended substrate/rim-material edge, which biases FCC photo 6 OUTWARD and FCC 6 is where the bound came from; and the sharper photograph measures 24.631 mm, below the 24.95 floor. The bound is NOT revised, because that third estimate's scale still comes from FCC 6 through the registration.
outer_diameter_mm.drawn_value_source: board/outline/outline-fit-oflynn.json - p_fit.py robust circle fit to the O'Flynn component-side outline, 1194 rays, 106.313 px/mm
outer_diameter_mm.drawn_value_is_not_independent: this millimetre inherits the SAME registration scale as every other number in this frame. It is a shape result. It is NOT a fourth opinion on the outer diameter and must never be quoted as one.
outer_diameter_mm.how_to_change_it: set this value; p_render.py normalises the fitted shape by the fitted diameter and multiplies by this one number, so the outline, the hole and every component position scale together. No diameter is hard-coded in any tool.

thickness_mm.fabrication_delta: L4 measured 0.30 mm is below PCBWay's 0.40 mm four-layer floor and JLCPCB's 0.40 mm minimum. The Replica AS DRAWN cannot be ordered at either house. That is a fact about US, not about Apple. The two numbers are never fused.

layer_count.state: MATCHES APPLE — COUNTED, no longer a Replica assumption
layer_count.apple_truth: 4, COUNTED from a published physical delayering (L4, stackup.json). Supersedes the earlier 'CANNOT DETERMINE in {4,6}'.
layer_count.evidence: stacksmashing/airtag-hardware pcb/layer1..layer4, credited to David Hulton. CITED, NOT REDISTRIBUTED — the source repo states no licence.
layer_count.discriminating_test: The 'merged layers' README was previously read as SUPERPOSITION, which would make four files carry no count. That reading is falsifiable and false: layer1 carries a fine-pitch square land grid with fanout — a feature only an OUTER layer can have — and layer2 at the SAME board location has none, only round via lands in a copper field. Superposition requires the grid present in every image. It is absent exactly where that reading demands it.
layer_count.structure: outer-with-pads / inner pour / inner routing / outer-with-pads; same outline, same centre hole, same three plated tooling holes at the same positions in all four.
layer_count.caveat: Measured by lane L4, not independently re-verified by the orchestrator. If the count is ever overturned this row moves with it — it is NOT an independent Replica decision that would survive the evidence changing.
layer_count.superseded_decision: The orchestrator authorised drawing 4 as a STATED REPLICA CHOICE within a {4,6} bound while Apple's count was unknown. The delayering evidence arrived in the same session and made that unnecessary. Recorded because the reasoning was right for the state of knowledge it was made in.

centre_hole.shape: SUPERELLIPSE + 7 MEASURED STRAIGHT FACETS - a rounded polygon, i.e. a routed pocket, not a smooth curve and not a circle
centre_hole.refusal: This lane publishes NO centre-hole diameter. Three superellipse fits disagree on the exponent and they disagree in DIFFERENT directions: FCC photo 6 gives n=2.70, L1's fit in the O'Flynn frame pinned n at its 2.00 bound, and p_fit.py's refit of L1's OWN boundary points gives n=2.449. n=2 is an ellipse; n=4 is a rounded square.
centre_hole.facets: 7 admitted, 1 refused. Each admitted only on INLIER SEPARATION against the superellipse, never on residual alone. They cut the residual 0.3342 -> 0.1987 mm (40.5%).
centre_hole.facets_earned: YES, and measured against a FABRICATION FLOOR: the same detector run on a synthetic PURE superellipse with the same sampling and noise finds 1 facet(s) and they buy -0.31%. 40.53% against that is real. Seven facets are fourteen extra parameters and extra parameters always lower a residual.
centre_hole.known_unmeasured: Each facet ends in a RADIAL STEP where its measured arc ends. A routed pocket really does have side walls, so a step is the right kind of geometry - but the arc ends are where the boundary crosses 0.30 mm from the superellipse, NOT where the wall is. The wall positions are NOT MEASURED.
rejected_alternatives: extending each facet to its natural crossing with the superellipse (+-25 deg): residual 0.3342 -> 0.4428 mm, WORSE, H3 turned NOT EARNED

inward facets as global half-plane clips, the operator the outer chords use: residual 0.3342 -> 0.4267 mm, also WORSE - the 5.746 mm facet spans only 0.96 mm of edge and clipping globally with it cuts 0.6 mm off a 35 deg arc where the measured boundary is farther out
centre_hole.drawn_from: board/outline/outline-fit-oflynn.json inner - refitted from L1's boundary points
centre_hole.earned_over_a_circle: YES, but only just and only because the improvement was measured against a floor: the superellipse beats a circle by 7.50%% in residual sd against a 1.53%% floor obtained by fitting the same pair of models to a synthetic PURE CIRCLE.

outline.note: The board is drawn from FITTED MANUFACTURABLE PRIMITIVES - a circle clipped by straight chords, and a superellipse hole - never from the per-degree silhouette. The silhouette carries the edge detector's noise, cannot be dimensioned or toleranced, and beside Apple's machined ring reads wrong for reasons unrelated to our dimensions. The raw profiles stay on disk as evidence and are NEVER merged into the fit file.
outline.fit_residual: published in the fit file and printed on the render: circle alone sd 0.5629 mm / 43.6% inliers; circle+4 chords sd 0.2771 mm / 55.8% inliers, band +-0.15 mm.

not_on_this_board.antennas: The three antennas are NOT on the PCB (evidence/E01). They live on a moulded carrier soldered to rim pads. Draw the RIM PADS and the feeds; never antennas in copper.
not_on_this_board.nfc_coil: WOUND MAGNET WIRE, ID 9.380 mm / OD 10.834 mm (L1). Not a trace, not copper on this board.

unpopulated.U1: The Apple U1 UWB module is never sold to anyone. U1 IS UNPOPULATED. That fact is printed ON THE BOARD in the legend, not only here.

components.orientation_source: ../metrology/components-front.json angle_deg / dark-packages-front.json angle_deg - the handoff drops the angle, the producing files keep it. Orientation is used ONLY for rows whose SIZE is trustworthy; a min-area-rect angle from an untrustworthy rect is untrustworthy too.
components.what_the_handoff_is: A LIST OF METAL AND BLUE. It is NOT a list of components. Its author's words.

drawing_rules.do_not_draw_as_component: NOT DRAWN. Counted on the picture with the reason.
drawing_rules.located_not_sized: drawn as a FIXED-SIZE position marker, never as a footprint. The position is usable; the size is not.
drawing_rules.on_rim_material_suspect: drawn in the suspect colour - it may be the grey fibrous rim material rather than a part (M02 sec 8, M09).
drawing_rules.known_gaps: the file names 4 positions that are EYEBALLED, measured:false, do_not_draw_as_measured:true. They are drawn as ABSENCE MARKERS in their own colour and never as parts. A miss written down is a different object from a miss not written down.

components.knowingly_incomplete: The largest dark body on the board is absent BY NAME, and so are the two gold-ringed round parts and the large silver clip beside the centre hole. Neutral-black packages are CANNOT DETERMINE after three detector attempts, one of which returned an answer that was purely a function of the operator's chosen box (34% swing on padding alone). The render will look sparse in the dark areas. That is the file being honest, not the drawing being broken. DO NOT FILL THE GAPS BY EYE.

not_drawn.antennas: The three antennas are NOT on this PCB (evidence/E01). They live on a moulded carrier. No antennas in copper, ever.
not_drawn.nfc_coil: WOUND MAGNET WIRE, ID 9.380 / OD 10.834 mm (L1). Not a trace, not copper on this board. Whether it is the NFC antenna or the voice coil is OPEN (evidence/E02).
not_drawn.rim_pads: NOT DRAWN. The rim pad COUNT is CANNOT DETERMINE and closed (M03/M05). The withdrawn 15- and 13-pad candidate angle sets FAILED A POSITIVE CONTROL and must not be drawn.
not_drawn.U1_footprint: NOT DRAWN, and the reason is not the same as the reason it is unpopulated. Its size is CANNOT DETERMINE: an independent remeasure of the can swings 6.735 -> 7.891 mm on the operator's padding alone (metrology/uwb-can-remeasure.json), and the only handoff row at that location is flagged merged_pad_run / do_not_draw_as_component. A footprint drawn from either would be a number invented by the operator.
